name: Privatzimmer Gruber Gottlieb
beschreibung: The Gasthof Gruber Gottlieb is located in Thiersee, a small village in the Tiroler Kaiserwinkl. The accommodation is quietly situated on the edge of the village center, surrounded by meadows and mountain scenery. Guests will find simple private rooms with traditional charm. The kitchen serves regional dishes in a cozy dining room. Thiersee is ideal for hiking and relaxing in nature.
